نستعير (form X)
# نَسْتَعِيرُ (nastaʕīru) /nas.ta.ʕiː.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعَارَ (istaʕāra)
# نَسْتَعِيرَ (nastaʕīra) /nas.ta.ʕiː.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعَارَ (istaʕāra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
